what_it_is.prose: Cyient Ltd (formerly Infotech Enterprises Ltd, founded 1991 in Hyderabad by B. V. R. Mohan Reddy) is an Indian engineering, network and operations (ER&D) technology services company. Cyient is a lifecycle engineering partner for aerospace & defense, offering design, certification, MRO, avionics and end-to-end product development. Key partnerships: (1) Honeywell — Cyient partners with Honeywell to manufacture Honeywell Anthem, the first cloud-connected cockpit system (18 July 2022); Cyient DLM signed a long-term deal with Honeywell Aerospace Technologies for aircraft cooling technology (6 November 2024); (2) Boeing — Cyient DLM signed a production contract with Boeing Global Services (BGS) for aerospace component production; (3) Other global A&D OEMs. Subsidiary Cyient DLM Ltd (Cyient Design-led Manufacturing) — Hyderabad-based integrated electronics & mechanical manufacturing partner for aerospace, defense and industrial markets — was spun off in an IPO in July 2023 (NSE:CYIENTDLM). Cyient is headquartered in Hyderabad and has market cap ~₹9,918 Cr.
